verdict.rationale: Fivetran can be driven headlessly: the REST API manages pipelines and the account programmatically, the Python Connector SDK deploys custom connectors with AI coding-agent CLI plugins to build, test and deploy them, and Hybrid Deployment Agents can run unattended under systemd. However, nothing in the pack documents CI-pipeline usage, and one community report says the APIs fail randomly, which lowers confidence. Missing for 10: an official platform CLI, documented CI/CD integration or examples, an OpenAPI spec (probe returned 404), and independent hands-on corroboration of reliable API-driven automation.
